name: Li Yao
current_role: Co-controlling shareholder (with husband Ye Delin) of New Pearl Group (Xinmingzhu), Foshan ceramic tiles maker
profile: Li Yao and her husband Ye Delin control New Pearl Group, a Foshan, Guangdong building-ceramics and tile maker founded in 1993 with production bases in Guangdong, Jiangxi and Chongqing. The couple jointly held about 86.67% of the company directly at end-2022. New Pearl's planned Shenzhen IPO has stalled since 2023.
interesting_fact: New Pearl is often described as a husband-and-wife company: Li Yao and Ye Delin directly held 86.67% of its equity at the end of 2022.
notes: Very private; husband Ye Delin (chairman/CEO, a former Nanzhuang town hydropower station head) is the public face. Approach via the company site. Avoid IPO/dividend controversies.
